4.en: Please dispose of batteries at a recycling center.
4.zh: 请把电池送到回收中心处理。

11.en: The battery is a key component of an electric car.
11.zh: 电池是电动汽车的关键组成部分。

12.en: The new rules impose limits on water use.
12.zh: 新规定对用水量设定了限制。

19.en: The purpose of this survey is to improve bus service.
19.zh: 这项调查的目的是改善公交服务。

21.en: Agriculture provides work for many people in the region.
21.zh: 农业为这个地区的许多人提供了工作。

33.en: The new policy received widespread support.
33.zh: 这项新政策得到了广泛支持。

36.en: The village was under siege for several weeks.
36.zh: 这个村庄被围困了好几个星期。

43.en: Schools can influence children outside the sphere of family life.
43.zh: 学校可以在家庭生活之外的领域影响孩子。

49.en: Please recycle glass bottles instead of throwing them away.
49.zh: 请回收玻璃瓶，不要把它们扔掉。

54.en: Good exercise helps blood circulate around the body.
54.zh: 适当运动有助于血液在全身循环。

57.en: The meaning of the word is clear from its context.
57.zh: 从上下文可以看出这个词的意思。

59.en: Residents held a protest against the plan to cut the trees.
59.zh: 居民举行抗议，反对砍伐树木的计划。
